About this piece

Oh man, this was a fun project. You can hear like a virus - Afreezy in my 🎹Music collection.

In short, Adam & I wanted to produce a song about how horribly the Trump Administration was running the response to COVID-19, so we did. And, because I love designing and photomanipulation, I produced this album artwork in an effort to stand out from the noise in the music world.

Funny enough, the song distribution service (the one that publishes to Spotify, Apple Music, etc.) would not let us publish with Donald Trump’s image on it. Apparently it violated some terms. So, I had to produce an alternate version:

Less fun, but still gets most of the point across! 😉
